correctness.rationale: For n≥3 banana graphs with positive lengths, the Len–Zakharov Kirchhoff–Prym formula reduces on a signed cover to the weighted cut Q(s)=sum_{i<j} w_ij(1−s_i s_j)/2, w_ij=prod_{k≠i,j} ell_k. For the disconnected all-equal class Q=0 is an explicitly formal extension. Singleton/doubleton cuts recover w_ij=(Q_i+Q_j−Q_ij)/2; product over pairs yields P=(prod w)^{1/binom(n−1,2)}=prod ell; positive ell_i=sqrt(P w_jk/(w_ij w_ik)). Walsh support in degrees 0,2, positivity and rank-one tetrads are necessary and sufficient for realizability; rank-one factorization is unique even at n=3 where tetrads vacuous. In n=2 cover Prym has dimension 0 and scalar volume cannot recover lengths. Independent rational all-pair inversion tested n=3,4,5,6.
